_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Malmö C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). OSM has no level tags here: the City Tunnel platforms (tracks 1–4) are taken from their layer (-2), and their three exits (Anna Lindhs plats, Posthusplatsen by the main building, and the east end) are joined to street level by hand, at the places Skånetrafiken's terminal map (June 2026) shows stairs and lifts. No in-between floors are modelled.
